Posting Detail Information

Position Summary
The Department
of Economics at the University at Buffalo, The State
University of New York, seeks to fill one Assistant
Teaching Professor (Non-Tenure-Track) position for an
economist committed to achieving excellence in instruction.

The position requires teaching 3 undergraduate courses each
semester, including large-enrollment introductory courses, and some
departmental service. We are seeking candidates committed to
developing careers in economics education.

This is a full-time, non-tenure-track qualified rank faculty
position (10-month obligation) ideally beginning with UB's spring
2027 semester, though fall 2027 start is possible. The initial
appointment will be for 3 years, with renewable 1-year terms.

JEL Classifications:
• 00 – Default: Any field
• A1 – General Economics
• A2 – Economic Education and Teaching of Economics

Applications received by October 11, 2026 will
receive priority consideration. The position will remain open until
filled. If you have questions, please email the posting contact,
and indicate “Assistant Teaching Professor Position” in the subject
of the email.

Applications must be submitted through UB Jobs https://www.ubjobs.buffalo.edu/postings/64268.
